summary: Council adopted a 45-day moratorium on new data centers 6-1 with one abstention. Under a staff amendment the city may continue to accept and process applications during the moratorium but may not approve them or issue permits.

source.citation: Contra Costa News and regional reporting, September 2026

notes: Councilmember Jamelia Brown abstained. Reported as the second city in Contra Costa County and the third in the Bay Area to adopt a moratorium, following Oakley and Gilroy. No pending data center applications were reported at adoption. The process-but-do-not-approve construction is a distinct instrument design not identified elsewhere in this corpus.
